⚔️ Phantom Blade Zero Modifier — Game Enhancer for Windows

 

 🛠️ PowerShell Setup Button

 

 

 

---

Phantom Blade Zero Modifier is a Windows 10/11 trainer built for players who want total control over their Phantom Blade Zero experience. Flip on God Mode, Infinite Health, One-Hit Kill, and Unlock All Weapons and Phantom Edges without touching a single crafting menu. Wulin Vision, Sixty-Six Days survival tools, and a full suite of toggles keep every run running exactly the way you want it. Steam-ready and engineered to stay invisible on stream.

 📋 System Requirements

- OS: Windows 10 / 11
- Shell: PowerShell 5.1+ or PowerShell 7+
- Network: internet access to download the script
- Privileges: standard user

 Features

 ⚔️ Combat Overhaul 
God Mode, One-Hit Kill, Auto-Parry, and Perfect Dodge turn every duel into a highlight reel. Infinite Combo keeps your chains alive while Infinite Health and Max Focus keep you in the fight longer than the enemy expects.

 🩸 Resource & Survival Control 
Infinite Sha-Chi, No Cooldowns, and No Crafting strip the grind out of every encounter. Sixty-Six Days survival mode becomes a playground instead of a punishment — stock your kit, set your pace, and push deeper than the base game allows.

 🗡️ Arsenal Unlocks 
Unlock All Weapons and every Phantom Edge from the jump. Wulin Vision reveals what the world hides, and full progression toggles let you set level, add skill points, and max stats on your terms.

 🏃 Movement & Positioning 
Super Speed, Infinite Jump, Ghost Mode, and Teleport to Waypoint give you total command of the battlefield. Reposition mid-fight, skip the backtracking, and scope out arenas before the first blade swings.

 ⚙️ Quality-of-Life Layer 
Save and load presets so your setup is ready in one click. A customizable menu and stream-proof overlay keep your session clean whether you're labbing combos or recording.

 🖥️ Built for Windows 10/11 
Engineered for the latest Steam build with a lightweight footprint and instant toggle response. No bloat, no background noise — just the options you want, live the moment you press INSERT.

 How it works

Phantom Blade Zero Modifier hooks directly into the game's running process on Windows 10/11 and flips the values that matter — health, Sha-Chi, focus, cooldowns, weapon unlocks — without touching your save file on disk. Launch the modifier, start Phantom Blade Zero, and attach once the main menu loads; the overlay stays out of the way until you call it up with a single key. Every option is a live toggle: God Mode, Infinite Health, One-Hit Kill, Unlock All Phantom Edges, No Crafting, Wulin Vision, and the rest of the roster apply instantly and revert the moment you switch them off. The trainer reads and writes memory in real time, so there's no patching, no modified executables, and nothing left behind after you close it. Presets let you save a loadout of active toggles and recall it in one click, and the stream-proof overlay keeps the menu invisible to capture software while you play. Built for the latest Steam and Epic builds, tuned against current patches, and lightweight enough to sit alongside the game without a frame hit.

 Supported Games

The Phantom Blade Zero Modifier is built and tuned for Phantom Blade Zero on PC, and it plays nice with the platforms you're actually launching it from.

- Phantom Blade Zero — Steam (Windows 10/11, 64-bit)
- Phantom Blade Zero — Epic Games Store
- Latest patch support — the modifier tracks the current Steam/Epic build so toggles stay responsive after updates
- Full option coverage — God Mode, Infinite Health, One-Hit Kill, Unlock All Weapons & Phantom Edges, No Crafting, Wulin Vision, Sixty-Six Days Survival, and the rest of the 50+ toggles are mapped to this title only

One game, one tool, zero guesswork. If Phantom Blade Zero is installed on your PC, the modifier is ready to roll with it.

 Configuration

The modifier ships pre-tuned, but Phantom Blade Zero gives you room to make it yours. Settings live in a single text file next to the launcher — the menu stays clean, the kit stays predictable.

 Open the menu in-game. Press INSERT (or rebind it in the config) to bring up the overlay. Every toggle applies live, so you can flip God Mode, Infinite Sha-Chi, or One-Hit Kill mid-fight without alt-tabbing into a restart.

 Tune the hotkeys. All 54 options have bindable keys. Edit config.ini to remap the toggle menu, quick-save presets, and the stream-proof layer. Duplicate a key and the launcher flags it before injection — no silent conflicts, no dead bindings at the worst possible moment.

 Save and load presets. Store up to 10 loadouts by category — combat, resources, movement, progression. Switch from a boss-fight setup to a Wulin Vision exploration build with one keystroke.

 Set the overlay behavior. Stream-proof mode is on by default: the overlay is hidden from OBS and Discord capture while staying fully visible on your monitor. Pick your render mode and opacity in the config; the overlay wears whatever style you give it.

 Keep it aligned with your patches. The launcher reads your game build from the config and runs a check on startup. Drop in the latest version and it re-syncs automatically — no manual hex edits, no guesswork. If the game patches, the tool tells you before you launch.

 Back up your config. Copy config.ini to a safe folder before a major game update. Your presets survive re-installs and patch rolls, and restoring takes seconds.

Defaults are tuned for stability out of the box. Tweak, save, and play — the Phantom Blade Zero Modifier is built to keep pace with your setup, not slow it down.

 FAQ

 Is Phantom Blade Zero Modifier really open to everyone? 
Yes — every option in the toolkit is accessible at zero cost. No paywalls, no premium tiers, no locked features. Grab it, run it, and the full loadout is yours.
